note: Laos: holders of ordinary passports of the countries the Ministry of Public Security lists enter without a visa (30 days for ASEAN, Belarus, Japan, Mongolia, Russia and South Korea; 15 for Luxembourg and Switzerland; 14 for Myanmar); others take a visa on arrival or an e-Visa, each for a stay of 30 days. The nationalities refused a visa on arrival aren't in the source, so every other passport is taken as eligible. Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Department of Immigration's own list (signed in Vientiane, 12 October 2022) and its visa page (a visa on arrival of up to 30 days): the list confirms every exemption held but gives Japan 15 days and Belarus and Timor-Leste none on an ordinary passport. Those three were kept at 30 days, because Wikipedia dates later changes the 2022 list predates (Japan's extended to 30 days from 1 June 2025, Timor-Leste's from 15 August 2025, Belarus' from 15 January 2026).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Laos
sources.said: According to the Ministry of Public Security of Laos , holders of ordinary passports of the following countries (including all ASEAN member states ) may enter Laos without a visa for stays up to the duration listed below: 30 days Belarus Brunei Cambodia Indonesia Japan Malaysia Mongolia Philippines Russia Singapore South Korea Thailand Timor-Leste Vietnam 15 days Luxembourg Switzerland 14 days Myanmar ... The duration of stay of a visa obtained upon arrival in Laos is 30 days

sources.title: Department of Immigration of Lao PDR, Visas
sources.said: Most travelers can acquire a visa on arrival at major entry points, such as international airports and border crossings. This visa allows for a stay of up to 30 days and can be extended once.
